scripts/validate/checks/qa-run-case-vocabulary.test.mjs:86-91 asserts assert.deepEqual(drivers, ['browser','http']), an exact multiset of qa-step-example markers. PRD AC-1 (PRPs/prds/qa-runner-case-vocabulary.prd.md:94) requires 'at least one literal JSON step object for each driver', a minimum; PRD AC-11 (line 104) requires a { action: 'query', ... } step, and plan Task 4 requires that example to carry the marker <!-- qa-step-example driver=http --> and at least 3 markers. Verified: plugins/relay/commands/relay-qa-run.md has markers at lines 161 (http), 171 (browser) and 182 (http, the query step); the test run reports actual ['browser','http','http'] vs expected ['browser','http'], the only failure. The test's exact-count assertion contradicts the PRD's plain reading and the plan. The change is an edit of an existing assertion (not purely additive), so DISPUTE_UPHELD_NEW_COVERAGE does not apply. The proposed set-of-drivers assertion with the per-block validateStep loop retained preserves AC-1's intent.

dispute_evidence.claim: The test asserts assert.deepEqual(drivers, ['browser','http']), an exact multiset of the doc's qa-step-example markers. PRD AC-1 (line 94) requires 'at least one literal JSON step object for each driver', which is a minimum, not an exact count. PRD AC-11 (line 104) requires a { action: 'query', ... } step. Plan Task 4 requires the query example to carry the exact marker <!-- qa-step-example driver=http --> and at least 3 qa-step-example markers. relay-qa-run.md has markers at lines 161 (http), 171 (browser), and 182 (http, the query step), so the doc yields ['browser','http','http']. The exact-multiset assertion contradicts the plan's own requirement.
dispute_evidence.proposed_resolution: Amend the test to assert the set of covered drivers, [...new Set(drivers)] deep-equal to ['browser','http'], and keep the per-block validateStep loop. Route it as EXISTING_TEST_UPDATED through the test pair.

Also note: QUERY_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE is a blocked reason code not listed in the plan's new-code inventory nor in relay-qa-run.md.
